containerDefinitions.name: llmtest
command:
import os, sys, time; from openai import OpenAI
print('MODEL_PROVIDER=' + os.getenv('MODEL_PROVIDER', 'NONE'))
print('DEFAULT_MODEL=' + os.getenv('DEFAULT_MODEL', 'NONE'))
print('OPENAI_API_KEY len=' + str(len(os.getenv('OPENAI_API_KEY', ''))))
try:
  c = OpenAI()
  t0 = time.time()
  r = c.chat.completions.create(model=os.getenv('DEFAULT_MODEL','gpt-4o-mini'), messages=[{'role':'user','content':'say hi in 3 words'}], timeout=20)
  print(f'OK [{(time.time()-t0):.1f}s]: {r.choices[0].message.content}')
except Exception as e:
  print(f'FAIL: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
